creature_companion.description: The common wolf of the Temperate Forest — grey-coated with faint silver-moss highlights along the back and flanks. Silvermoss wolves are the ordinary wolves of the realm's well-settled forests: capable hunters, good pack coordinators, and reliable companions for rangers and hunters who work the standard woodland territories.
creature_companion.temperament: Steady, unflashy, dependable. A practical working wolf for handlers who need reliable pack coordination without Feywood strangeness.
